definitions.explanation: Saliva that drips or flows from the mouth, especially during sleep or when seeing delicious food. Common in everyday speech.

examples.japanese: よだれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧よだれ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{垂|た}らしている→垂らす：05339_tarasu⟧。
おいしそうな⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧よだれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I drooled looking at the delicious-looking food.

notes:
よだれ refers to saliva that drips from the mouth, whether involuntarily (during sleep, in babies) or in response to appetizing food.

WRITING:
Can be written as {涎|よだれ}, but hiragana is far more common.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- よだれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to drool
- よだれ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{垂|た}らす→垂らす：05339_tarasu⟧: to drool, to dribble
- よだれ{掛|か}け: bib (for babies)
- よだれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ほどおいしい: so delicious it makes you drool

USAGE:
Often used figuratively to express strong desire or craving. よだれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ can mean 'to be mouth-watering' when talking about desirable food or even coveted objects.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {唾|つば}/⟦{唾液|だえき}→唾液：15943_daeki⟧: saliva (medical/neutral; not specifically drool)
- {涎|よだれ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{垂|た}らす→垂らす：05339_tarasu⟧ is more vivid and informal than ⟦{唾液|だえき}→唾液：15943_daeki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧
